description: Topics for the whole KR Part 2 extraction (kr-2026-part2-rules.jsonl). Maps the observation kind the agent looks up (or wording in a free-text report) to a search query and the ID prefixes (chapter/section ranges) it may draw from. Topics are tried in order for free text, so the narrower repair and re-check topics come before FITUP.
